money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $50,000.00

output.headline: Approves a no-cost data-sharing agreement with the University of California for a student progress study
output.summary: The University of California will provide secure web tools so the district can send student records to UC for an evaluation called UC COMPASS. The evaluation checks whether students are on track to meet requirements for California public colleges and universities. The agreement runs July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2027 and costs the district nothing.

output.headline: Pays a literacy consultant up to $114,800 to train special education teachers

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $114,800.00

output.summary: The consultant will train special education teachers on a literacy curriculum, including the SPIRE and Lexia reading programs, and track teacher use and student progress data. The consultant will also help manage the literacy work in the district's Disability Access Resolution Literacy Plan. The contract runs August 14, 2025 through June 30, 2026, and the board is ratifying it after it began.

output.headline: Approves a no-cost deal for University of San Francisco Upward Bound college prep at three high schools
output.summary: The University of San Francisco's Upward Bound Project will offer workshops, advising, help with college and financial aid applications, and tutoring connections to students at Fremont, Castlemont and Oakland High Schools. A separate data-sharing agreement sets rules for how the district shares student data with the university and how the university protects it. Both run July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2027 at no cost to the district.
